description: Source code for the OutputVulkanGLSL class, which outputs shaders compatible with GL_KHR_vulkan_glsl, part of the ANGLE project. Contains methods for writing layout qualifiers, qualifiers, variable types, and struct types specific to Vulkan GLSL shader output.

classes.name: TOutputVulkanGLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Vulkan GLSL shader code with specific layout and qualifier handling.

methods.name: writeLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Writes layout qualifiers for shader variables, handling interface blocks and storage formats.

methods.name: writeFieldLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Handles layout qualifiers for interface block fields; currently a placeholder as Vulkan GLSL doesn't allow qualifiers on fields.

methods.name: writeQualifier
methods.description: Writes qualifiers for shader variables, including special handling for interface blocks and varying qualifiers.

methods.name: writeVariableType
methods.description: Outputs the variable type, with special handling for external sampler types.

methods.name: writeStructType
methods.description: Declares a struct type if not already declared.
